ev.q: During 2020, the number of HIV tests decreased 32% from Q1 (2,471,614) to Q2 (1,682,578)
The number of persons prescribed ART did not vary
the proportion with a suppressed viral load test result among those tested was stable
the percentage who were linked to care did not vary during 2019–2020, ranging from 88.0% to 89.4%
persons aged ≥35 years experienced the largest quarter-to-quarter decrease in number of HIV tests
the number of persons who received a diagnosis of HIV infection in 2020 decreased from Q1 to Q2
quarterly data from two large U.S. commercial laboratories
Poisson regression models were used to assess trends in service use and outcomes by calculating the estimated quarterly percent change (EQPC)
